usageNotes: Use this endpoint to check the currently installed versions of key Proxmox Backup Server packages on a given node — useful for verifying the PBS software stack before or after an `apt-upgrade` operation. The response scope is limited to packages that PDM considers important (not the full dpkg database). The node must be online and reachable by PDM; requires the System.Audit privilege.

examples.summary: List installed PBS package versions on node 'pbs01'

tips: The 'OldVersion' field is only present when an upgrade is available; if absent, the installed version matches 'Version'.
Use this alongside get_nodes_node_apt_update to first refresh the package index, then call this endpoint to see current vs. available versions.
Passing 'localhost' as the node name works when calling the API directly on the PDM node itself.
